0022600154.text: Orlando (2-3, 4th in the Southeast, 0.5 games back) hosts Boston (4-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, on a four-game winning streak), and the Celtics are 4-0 at home while the Magic are 0-2 at home. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and has Mitchell Robinson listed as day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Magic lost 1-3, including a 113-108 loss in Boston on April 12, 2026.
